```yaml
name: Chromatic Visual Regression Testing

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Build project
        run: pnpm run build

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: pnpm test
        env:
          CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN }}

  chromatic:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run Chromatic
        run: npx chromatic --playwright
        env:
          CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN }}
```

This GitHub Actions workflow sets up a CI pipeline for running visual regression tests using Chromatic with Playwright for a Next.js project. The workflow includes two jobs: `build-and-test`, which builds the project and runs Playwright tests, and `chromatic`, which runs Chromatic after the tests have been executed. The `CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN` environment variable is required and should be set in the repository's secrets.
